scope: Ironclad / Geo Lumine / Act 1 / PC A0
policy: Inventory of current production wiring, not a runtime admission switch or a claim of per-item platform acceptance. Any scope change must update this file and its evidence.

knownBlockers.detail: Spirit Poop obtain/display is wired; -1 score helper is not consumed by a production total-score calculation.

cards.limitation: 75 base/upgraded ordinary executions and focused interactions covered locally; full source/queue/RNG/acquisition parity and natural per-item platform evidence remain required.

generatedCards.limitation: Four statuses and ten curses are defined; nine curses were added beyond Regret. Only Regret, Doubt and Pain have wired event additions (the latter two explicit-only); seven other added curses have no natural acquisition route. Explicit Run.obtainCard fixtures do not establish natural acquisition. None count toward 75 class cards.

enemies.limitation: Encounter construction coverage does not establish every AI branch, source parity or natural victory.

encounters.limitation: 17 source queue bindings plus Guardian-unseen Boss. Formal Nodes entry and finite formation member ranges are inspected separately from legacy explicit IDs. Per-item natural acquisition, platform and live verification remain pending.

events.limitation: Seven default random events; six additional explicit routes including Living Wall, Fountain and four Act 1 events. Full source event-pool admission, per-option natural eligibility and platform/live execution remain pending.

relics.limitation: All 33 common effects and three SPECIAL definitions/obtain behavior plus Warped Tongs turn hook are integrated offline. Treasure/shop still use restricted local selection; the complete source queue is wired to event preparation, not treasure/shop. Missing non-common definitions cause atomic refusal, never effect-based rerolls. SPECIAL are event-only legal channels and treasure candidates now admit only common/uncommon/rare, retaining the existing gold fallback when none are legal. Spirit Poop total-score deduction has only a helper and no production score consumer. Natural acquisition and platform/live evidence remain pending.

potions.limitation: 27 Ironclad potion effects defined; six obtainable through restricted combat/shop pools, 21 acquisitionPending and enumerated in exclusions until complete ordered 33-potion pool integration. Poison Potion remains Silent-exclusive. Effect fixtures do not grant acquisition/platform/live acceptance.

bosses.limitation: One Boss on floor 16, separate treasure on 17. M2 completion does not prove every Guardian transition.

legacyEncounters.limitation: Historical explicit-ID development/replay inputs, not the formal source queue or natural acquisition channels.
